item.title: Gauhati HC Upholds Order Directing Refund of ₹4.90 Lakh in Truck Sale Dispute
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Gauhati High Court has dismissed an appeal filed by a woman challenging an order directing her to refund ₹4.90 lakh to a third party in connection with the sale of a truck purchased under a hire-purchase agreement. The court held that the appellant had no ownership right over the vehicle during the subsistence of the loan and therefore could not have sold or transferred it. item.title: Homebound Shortlisted for Oscars in Best International Feature Category
item.description: GUWAHATI: Homebound, directed by Neeraj Ghaywan and produced by Karan Johar, has been shortlisted for the Best International Feature Film category at the 98th Academy Awards. The film was India’s official entry for the Oscars and is now among 15 international titles competing for a place in the final nominations, which will be announced on January 22. item.title: Priyanghsu Phukan from Gauhati University Selected for Republic Day Parade Camp of 2026 in New Delhi
item.description: GUWAHATI: Priyangshu Phukan, an NSS volunteer from the Gauhati University Campus NSS Unit and a Master’s student of the Department of Education, has been selected for the Republic Day Parade Camp to be held in New Delhi from January 1 to January 31 next year. He will represent Gauhati University and Assam at the national-level event. item.title: Assam's Dudhnoi College Gets NCTE Recognition for Integrated Teacher Education Programme
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam’s Dudhnoi College in Goalpara district has received recognition from the National Council for Teacher Education for running the four-year Integrated Teacher Education Programme, beginning from the academic session 2026–27. The recognition was granted by the Eastern Regional Committee of the NCTE under the provisions of the NCTE Act.
